title: 戈登路巡捕房南院面中央山墙与柱廊
observed_scope: 面向庭院的中央三角山墙、其下弧楣门套、中上两层窗、左右凹入柱廊及短折墙。建筑师正面原图第03号显示入口石套与顶层拱形木窗，连续栏杆分隔上下廊。陡坡只制作这一段的可见屋面。

photography.historic_overall: University of Bristol, Historical Photographs of China, William Grant Collection, WG01-191, estimated 1908–1915. The archive identifies both the station and the surviving building.
photography.historic_portal: University of Bristol, Historical Photographs of China, Harold Peck Collection, Pe01-061, estimated 1910–1920. Hollow bowed lintel with stepped architrave and vertical jambs.
photography.rehabilitation: Neri&Hu, The Recontextualiztion of History | Design Republic Design Commune, 511 Jiangning Road, completed November 2012. The project page dates the work and does not supply a separate exposure date for every image.
photography.roof: Fayhoo, Gorden Road Station.jpg, 2017-03-04 15:13:36. Rooftop form photographed from above. CC BY-SA 3.0.
photography.orientation: 2016-07-07 published architectural description explicitly identifies the central reinforced-concrete entrance and wood frame on the south face. Independently confirm against the host footprint before assigning a cut.

interpretation.names: 原牌署与市表建筑同址。设计单位称设计共和办公室／展示空间改造。市表列名为登记时的使用单位。
interpretation.dates: Bristol两件档案均将培训站建筑记为1908。阅读静安记1909工部局出资、1910建成；Neri&Hu称1910年代。展页保留两种记录。
interpretation.limits: 建筑师另将街侧商铺改为玻璃附体。原门扇更换层次、隐于廊后的墙、全院附属建筑及远端屋顶无完整逐件史料。原档案不用于推出学校等当代使用细节。

spatial: 市表具名段OSM 490281437版本2与14-13719-6694原1295的IoU为98.51%。南面长边43.9米、切线方位68.5度。Fayhoo相机记录在楼北偏西，框中向其突出的三道屋顶仅作北侧屋顶和同栋的旁证。南院面建模直接依据建筑师中央原图与WG01-191、Pe01-061。江宁路在楼东北侧、康定路隔院在南；二者均不等于整栋的南院面。
rights: 对照建筑形体自行绘制。建筑师项目照片与Bristol藏品只在作者研究留证，发行的模型不贴原图。Fayhoo照片另依CC BY-SA 3.0列署名与许可证链接。
